newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see strong enquiry.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see strong enquiry.

text.p: The European cotton market saw enquiry up ahead of next week's forecast of U.S. output but few firm trades resulted, industry sources said on Thursday.

Central Asian and West African descriptions continue to attract the most attention - particularly in the UK and Germany - but buyers remain generally unwilling to contract beyond three to four months ahead, they said.
Only Portugal bucked the trend with shipments secured for mid-1997 and later.
